statement_made: It's one of the better feelings in the world to be able to go back to your hometown team, put on that orange and black, and get ready for Who Dey nation.
event_description: Reacting to being drafted by his hometown team, the Cincinnati Bengals, in the sixth round.

statement_made: My versatility to play all five (positions) will help strengthen that unit and keep Joe Burrow safe.
event_description: Discussing how his experience at both tackle and center will contribute to the Bengals' offensive line.

statement_made: I was a fifth-generation Longhorn... I just knew that if you believe in yourself and you do what your heart is telling you to do and you just keep pushing, anything is possible.
event_description: Reflecting on his journey from a walk-on at Texas to being drafted by the Miami Dolphins.

statement_made: You’ve got to earn your stripes early. You’ve got to put your head down and not say a word and be humble. Once it’s your time to talk, then that’s when you use your voice.
event_description: Discussing his approach to leadership as a rookie entering the Dolphins' locker room.

statement_made: We couldn't have asked for a better scenario. Downs should immediately be one of the best players on a defense that needs his instincts.
event_description: Cowboys owner expressing excitement after trading up to select safety Caleb Downs.

statement_made: I haven't seen many draft rooms more excited than the Bucs were when Bain fell to them. He's a key part of our comeback efforts.
event_description: Buccaneers GM discussing the 'pleasant surprise' of Rueben Bain Jr. being available at No. 15.

statement_made: He's a good person. We had known about the incident long before it became public and had no misgivings about selecting him.
event_description: Licht addressing character concerns regarding Rueben Bain Jr. following a past traffic incident.

statement_made: You go to bed at night, and you’re like, holy cow, we got a pretty good list here. Some years the guys you want actually get to you.
event_description: Bengals Director of Player Personnel reflecting on the team's draft board and value picks.

statement_made: I am not down on my linebackers. They individually will improve and collectively will improve by the experience they've gained.
event_description: Tobin defending the current linebacker corps while discussing post-draft roster additions.

statement_made: Dallas is a legendary franchise. I’m ready to come in, learn the system, and contribute to a championship culture.
event_description: Initial reaction after being selected 11th overall by the Dallas Cowboys.

statement_made: I know what I bring to the table. I’m grateful to the Cardinals for the opportunity to prove I can lead at this level.
event_description: Addressing his third-round selection by Arizona after falling further than some projected.

statement_made: To play for a coach like Mike McCarthy is an honor. I’m ready to soak up everything and work on my game every day.
event_description: Discussing his development as a third-round pick for the Pittsburgh Steelers.

statement_made: Philly is home. Happy to have the news out there and just focus on the season ahead.
event_description: Reaction to the Philadelphia Eagles officially exercising his fifth-year option.

statement_made: I love the direction this team is heading. I’m honored to be a part of the Titans' future.
event_description: Responding to reports that the Titans plan to exercise his fifth-year option.

statement_made: The Saints have a great tradition of defensive backs. I’m here to add to that and win.
event_description: Brief comments after signing a contract with New Orleans on April 28.

statement_made: Grateful for the chance in New Orleans. Ready to get to work with this group.
event_description: Announcing his free agent signing with the Saints.

statement_made: Cleveland, let's go. Ready to bring that physical presence to the backfield.
event_description: Social media post following his signing with the Browns.

statement_made: Fired up to join the Steelers. Can't wait to get in the room and compete.
event_description: Reacting to his late-April signing with Pittsburgh.

statement_made: Blessed to be back with the Chiefs. Ready to build on what we did last year.
event_description: Commenting on signing his exclusive rights tender with Kansas City.

statement_made: Minnesota is where I want to be. Glad to have this settled so we can focus on football.
event_description: Confirming his re-signing with the Vikings after being tendered as an ERFA.
